verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence shows Fireflies letting users schedule recurring jobs or workflows, such as cron-style tasks or recurring reports. What it does document is adjacent and earns no credit: calendar auto-join, an admin Rules Engine for meeting access and privacy, event-driven webhooks, and Zapier hookups (a user-side workaround). The axis still applies, because a meeting-intelligence SaaS could plausibly ship scheduled automations, so absence of evidence means none rather than na.
